papers.title_zh: 高PD-L1表达与EGFR突变NSCLC一线奥希替尼更短 rwPFS 和 OS 相关：多中心真实世界验证研究（WJOG 20724L）
papers.title_en: High PD-L1 Expression and Clinical Outcomes of First-Line Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutant NSCLC: A Multicenter Real-World Validation Study (WJOG 20724L).
papers.authors: Sakata Y, Murotani K, Fujimoto D, Toi Y, Yokoyama T, Katakura S, Yamaguchi T, Tanaka K et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Respiratory Medicine, Saiseikai Kumamoto Hospital, Kumamoto, Japan.
papers.results: 队列A：高PD-L1表达与更短 rwPFS 相关（HR=1.95，95%CI 1.30-2.92，p=0.001）和更短 OS（HR=1.72，95%CI 1.02-3.09，p=0.044）。队列B：rwPFS HR=1.76（95%CI 1.30-2.37，p<0.001），OS HR=1.92（95%CI 1.28-2.87，p=0.002）。未校正分析与倾向性评分校正分析结果一致。主要终点为rwPFS，次要终点为OS和至治疗失败时间。
papers.authors_conclusion: 高PD-L1表达与EGFR突变NSCLC一线奥希替尼临床获益降低相关；这些发现应被解读为真实世界实践中一致的临床关联，而非预测性生物标志物的确切证据。
papers.ai_note: ①回顾性真实世界设计，非前瞻性验证，残余混杂（如PS评分、脑转移比例、合并症等倾向性评分未涵盖因素）无法完全排除；②PD-L1检测抗体、平台在多中心间可能不统一，TPS≥50%阈值为事后或非预设定义的可能信息不足；③作者结论措辞审慎，明确区分关联与预测性标志物，此点值得肯定；④OS在队列A中HR=1.72，CI下限1.02接近无效线，OS事件数可能有限，稳健性存疑；⑤无PFS/OS绝对中位数及事件数报告，信息不足；⑥未报告高PD-L1亚组后续治疗（如含铂化疗±免疫治疗）情况，无法排除后续治疗差异对OS的影响；⑦该关联是否可转化为治疗决策（如高PD-L1患者一线联合化疗）尚无前瞻性证据支持，不宜直接指导临床。

pico.p: EGFR突变NSCLC一线奥希替尼治疗患者；队列A（非重叠验证队列）200例，队列B（全队列，PD-L1状态已知）385例，来源于日本16家机构
pico.ic: 按PD-L1 TPS分层比较：高表达（≥50%）vs 低表达（<50%），非干预性观察性研究，无对照治疗

papers.reason: 影响EGFR突变晚期NSCLC一线治疗策略思考：高PD-L1是否提示奥希替尼单药获益不足、是否需联合化疗；同时为后续前瞻性生物标志物研究提供假设生成依据和效应量参考；审慎的结论表述可作为真实世界关联性研究的写作范例。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Osimertinib is the standard first-line therapy for EGFR-mutated NSCLC. Nevertheless, the clinical significance of high programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression in this setting remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the association between a high PD-L1 tumor proportion score (≥50%) and clinical outcomes in patients treated with first-line osimertinib. METHODS: This multicenter retrospective study used the REAL-WIND database from 16 Japanese institutions. Among 486 patients with EGFR-mutated NSCLC treated with first-line osimertinib, 385 patients with known PD-L1 status formed the full cohort (cohort B). After excluding 185 patients who overlapped with the published OSI-FACT data set, 200 patients formed the non-overlapping validation cohort (cohort A). Patients were stratified by PD-L1 tumor proportion score (≥50% versus <50%). The primary end point was real-world progression-free survival (rwPFS), and secondary end points were overall survival (OS) and time to treatment failure. Outcomes were evaluated using unadjusted analyses and propensity score-based analyses to assess the robustness of the observed associations. RESULTS: In cohort A, high PD-L1 expression was associated with shorter rwPFS (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.95, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.30-2.92, p = 0.001) and OS (HR = 1.72, 95% CI: 1.02-3.09, p = 0.044). Similar associations were observed in cohort B for rwPFS (HR = 1.76, 95% CI: 1.30-2.37, p < 0.001) and OS (HR = 1.92, 95% CI: 1.28-2.87, p = 0.002). These associations were consistent in unadjusted analyses and in propensity score-based analyses adjusting for baseline confounding, supporting the reproducibility of the findings in this real-world cohort. CONCLUSIONS: High PD-L1 expression was associated with reduced clinical benefit from first-line osimertinib in EGFR-mutated NSCLC. These findings should be interpreted as a consistent clinical association observed in real-world practice, rather than definitive evidence of a predictive biomarker.

papers.title_zh: IASLC三级组织学分级与浸润性非黏液型肺腺癌淋巴结转移及脏层胸膜侵犯的关联：7806例手术队列（含≤2 cm亚组）
papers.title_en: Association of the IASLC histologic grading system with aggressive pathologic features in invasive non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma.
papers.authors: Han H, Zhu Z, Gao J, Liu Y, Hu M, Qiu X, Zhang X, Liu Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Medical School of Chinese PLA, Beijing 100853, China; Department of Thoracic Surgery, the First Medical Centre, Chinese …
papers.results: grade 1–3淋巴结转移率分别为0.7%、4.9%、31.0%，脏层胸膜侵犯率分别为2.0%、9.6%、33.6%（all P < 0.001）；以grade 1为参照，grade 3校正后OR：淋巴结转移37.48（95% CI 22.06–63.70），脏层胸膜侵犯14.10（95% CI 9.81–20.27）。≤2 cm亚组淋巴结转移率0.3%、2.8%、19.9%，grade 3校正后OR 48.66（95% CI 21.88–108.25）；分级对淋巴结转移的判别力在≤2 cm肿瘤中更强（P for interaction = 0.006）。任何比例的微乳头成分在校正分级后仍与淋巴结转移独立相关（OR 1.84，95% CI 1.33–2.56；≤2 cm亚组 OR 1.78，95% CI 1.06–3.00）。
papers.authors_conclusion: Higher IASLC grade was directly associated with lymph node metastasis and visceral pleural invasion in invasive non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma, including among ≤2 cm nodules; grade 3 identifies a very-high-risk subgroup. Histologic grading may inform surgical strategy and lymph node dissection in small-nodule lung cancer.
papers.ai_note: 主要结局为病理学替代终点（淋巴结转移、胸膜侵犯），摘要未报告无复发生存或总生存等临床硬终点，'可指导手术策略与淋巴结清扫'属外推；单中心回顾性、仅纳入已手术患者，存在选择/谱系偏倚，未见外部验证；淋巴结转移率差异亦可能受手术医师清扫范围与病理取材影响，信息不足。微乳头成分分析为校正分级后的附加/次要分析，非预设主要终点；grade 3仅496例，OR极宽（22.06–63.70），估计稳定性有限。

pico.p: 2011–2025年接受手术切除、无新辅助治疗且可按IASLC标准分级的浸润性非黏液型肺腺癌患者7,806例（grade 1: 3,435；grade 2: 3,875；grade 3: 496）
pico.ic: 暴露为IASLC组织学分级（grade 1/2/3，以grade 1为参照）；对照为各等级间比较，另设≤2 cm肿瘤亚组与不同比例微乳头成分亚组分析；观察性研究，无干预分配

papers.reason: 为≤2 cm肺腺癌是否需更广泛淋巴结评估及分级能否纳入术中决策提供大样本病理关联证据，直接影响小结节手术范围与淋巴结清扫策略的讨论；同时为组织学分级研究的效应量提供参照基线
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The IASLC three-tiered histologic grading system for invasive non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma, which combines the predominant subtype with a ≥ 20% high-grade pattern threshold, remains insufficiently validated in screening-era populations dominated by small nodules. We examined its association with lymph node metastasis and visceral pleural invasion in a large single-center surgical cohort. METHODS: We retrospectively enrolled 7,806 patients who underwent resection of invasive non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma between 2011 and 2025 without neoadjuvant therapy and could be graded per IASLC criteria (grade 1, 3,435; grade 2, 3,875; grade 3, 496). Multivariable logistic regression adjusted for tumor diameter, age, sex, and year of surgery, with trend tests, a grade-by-size interaction test, and prespecified subgroup analyses. RESULTS: Across grades 1-3, lymph node metastasis rates were 0.7%, 4.9%, and 31.0%, and visceral pleural invasion rates were 2.0%, 9.6%, and 33.6% (all P < 0.001); versus grade 1, adjusted ORs for grade 3 were 37.48 (95% CI 22.06-63.70) and 14.10 (95% CI 9.81-20.27). In the ≤ 2 cm subgroup, lymph node metastasis rates were 0.3%, 2.8%, and 19.9%, with a grade 3 adjusted OR of 48.66 (95% CI 21.88-108.25); the discriminatory performance of grade for lymph node metastasis was stronger in tumors ≤ 2 cm (P for interaction = 0.006). A micropapillary component of any proportion remained independently associated with lymph node metastasis after adjustment for grade (OR 1.84, 95% CI 1.33-2.56; ≤2 cm subgroup: OR 1.78, 95% CI 1.06-3.00). CONCLUSIONS: Higher IASLC grade was directly associated with lymph node metastasis and visceral pleural invasion in invasive non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma, including among ≤ 2 cm nodules; grade 3 identifies a very-high-risk subgroup. Histologic grading may inform surgical strategy and lymph node dissection in small-nodule lung cancer.

papers.title_zh: mCARG评分指导老年/晚期脆弱NSCLC患者一线治疗强度的随机II期试验：主要终点3/4级治疗相关不良事件两策略无差异，缓解者早期转durvalumab的OS差异未达统计学显著
papers.title_en: Modified CARG Score-Guided First-Line Treatment in Older or Vulnerable Patients With Advanced Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer: Results of the Randomized, Phase 2 DURATION Trial (AIO-YMO/TRK-0416).
papers.authors: Kuon J, Blasi M, Bozorgmehr F, Kokowski K, Faehling M, Schütt P, Christoph DC, Kimmich M et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Oncology, Thoraxklinik at Heidelberg University Hospital, Heidelberg, Germany; Translational Lung…
papers.results: 中位随访36.8个月；两种治疗策略间3/4级治疗相关不良事件无差异（P=.81，主要终点）；mCARG≤3患者较mCARG>3患者PFS更长（6.1 vs 3.2个月，HR 0.54）、OS更长（10.2 vs 5.3个月，HR 0.48），且未增加严重毒性；缓解者中早期转durvalumab者缓解持续时间更长、OS数值上更长（25.3 vs 11.3个月，P=.057）
papers.authors_conclusion: 前瞻性mCARG评分导向的治疗分配是可行的；较低mCARG评分与更优结局相关且未增加严重毒性，尽管这些差异主要应解读为预后性的；缓解者中早期转durvalumab与更长缓解持续时间和数值上更长的OS相关，支持在老年和脆弱患者中进一步评估该策略
papers.ai_note: 主要终点（3/4级TRAEs）为阴性（P=.81），结论转而强调缓解者亚组的DoR与OS（P=.057未达显著），属选择性强调次要/探索性终点；mCARG≤3 vs >3的PFS/OS差异来自非随机的分层比较（作者亦承认应视为预后性），不可作为评分指导疗效的证据；缓解者分析为随机化后的条件化亚组，存在选择偏倚；开放标签设计对毒性终点评估亦有影响；摘要未报告各随机层内组间样本量、CI及次要终点的多重性校正，信息不足

pico.p: 201例转移性NSCLC患者，年龄≥70年和/或Charlson合并症指数>1和/或ECOG PS≥2；中位年龄76岁，30% ECOG PS≥2，57% CCI>1；按mCARG评分分层（mCARG≤3 vs >3）
pico.ic: 层内随机：4周期化疗 vs 2周期化疗后转durvalumab；mCARG≤3层接受含铂双药化疗，mCARG>3层接受单药化疗

papers.reason: 影响老年/脆弱晚期NSCLC一线治疗强度与免疫治疗时机的决策：提示按mCARG分配化疗强度不增加严重毒性但主要毒性终点无差异，同时为老年肺癌试验设计与预后分层工具的验证提供方法学参考
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Older and vulnerable patients with metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) are underrepresented in clinical trials, and evidence guiding treatment intensity remains limited. We investigated whether a modified Cancer and Aging Research Group (mCARG) score could prospectively guide chemotherapy intensity according to estimated toxicity risk. METHODS: In this randomized, open-label phase II study, 201 patients with metastatic NSCLC aged ≥ 70 years and/or Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI) > 1 and/or ECOG performance status ≥ 2 were stratified by mCARG score. Patients with mCARG ≤ 3 received platinum-doublet chemotherapy (CTX), whereas those with mCARG > 3 received single-agent CTX. Within each stratum, patients were randomized to 4 cycles of CTX or 2 cycles followed by durvalumab. The primary endpoint was grade 3/4 treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs). RESULTS: Median age was 76 years; 30% had ECOG performance status ≥ 2 and 57% had CCI > 1. After 36.8 months median follow-up, grade 3/4 TRAEs did not differ between treatment strategies (P = .81). Patients with mCARG ≤ 3 had longer PFS (6.1 vs. 3.2 months; HR 0.54) and OS (10.2 vs. 5.3 months; HR 0.48) than patients with mCARG > 3, without increased severe toxicity. Among responders, early transition to durvalumab was associated with longer duration of response and numerically longer OS (25.3 vs. 11.3 months; P = .057). CONCLUSION: Prospective mCARG-based treatment allocation was feasible. Lower mCARG scores were associated with favorable outcomes without increased severe toxicity, although these differences should primarily be interpreted as prognostic. Early transition to durvalumab was associated with prolonged response duration and numerically longer OS among responders, supporting further evaluation of this strategy in older and vulnerable patients.

papers.title_en: Learning curve of da vinci robotic lobectomy: a single-surgeon CUSUM analysis of operative time and perioperative outcomes.
papers.authors: Lo CM, Tsai MY, Huang DKR, Lai HH, Chen Y, Li SH
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic & Cardiovascular Surgery, Kaohsiung Chang Gung Memorial Hospital, Chang Gung University College o…
papers.results: CUSUM手术时间曲线峰值位于第20例（值265.0），第10例处存在近似局部峰值（260.5）；留一法及平滑分析显示峰值在10~20例间不稳定；CUSUM路径未超出置换检验95%决策限包络（全局p=0.73）。早期vs晚期手术时间中位数315.0（IQR 283.8-357.2）vs 284.0（268.5-338.0）分钟（p=0.186）；病例序号与手术时间无单调趋势（Spearman ρ=0.01，p=0.93）。胸管留置时间在两阶段间差异有统计学意义：Mann-Whitney检验p=0.041，Kaplan-Meier/log-rank χ²=5.43，p=0.020（次要终点，未校正多重比较）。Charlson合并症指数随病例序号显著升高（ρ=0.34，p=0.02）；恶性组织学比例65% vs 89%（p=0.07）；合并手术5% vs 19%（p=0.22）；肿瘤大小中位数2.2 vs 2.1 cm（p=0.80）。校正前后病例序号与手术时间关联无实质变化：未校正-0.03 min/例（95%CI -1.53至+1.46），完全校正+0.12（95%CI -1.48至+1.72），早期-晚期差异-23.1 min（未校正）vs -16.0 min（校正后），所有p≥0.27。至CUSUM断点（第20例肺叶切除）时术者累计已行39例机器人手术（含肺段切除、楔形切除及da Vinci SP）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 在该单术者系列中，手术时间CUSUM断点（约10~20例）应视为探索性、描述性信号，而非经正式验证的学习-熟练度转变，因该断点与随机变异无统计学区分且二分早期/晚期手术时间比较不显著。合并症负担在研究期间显著增加，手术复杂度指标趋势一致，校正后未改变手术时间估计，因此无证据表明术者逐步选择更简单病例；但小样本无法得出确切结论。术者在断点时的累计机器人经验远超单纯肺叶切除例数。
papers.ai_note: 1）胸管留置时间差异（p=0.020~0.041）为次要终点且未校正多重比较，摘要中被突出展示，需审慎解读。2）调整模型置信区间宽（如完全校正后-1.48至+1.72 min/例），无法排除中等大小效应，'无差异'结论受样本量限制。3）该术者在纳入研究前已有机器人手术经验（截至第20例肺叶切除时累计39例机器人手术），研究结果可能仅适用于已有一定机器人基础的术者初始肺叶切除经验，不可简单外推至完全初学者。4）全部患者无胸膜粘连，粘连相关学习曲线未被评估。5）入组时间跨度（2024年9月至2026年7月）较长，摘要未说明是否所有患者已完成随访。

papers.abstract_en: To characterize the operative-time learning curve for da Vinci robotic-assisted lobectomy in a single surgeon's initial experience, and to examine, using trend analyses of patient comorbidity and surgical-complexity variables and adjusted regression models, whether any apparent change in operative time was influenced by a shift in case complexity. We retrospectively reviewed 47 consecutive patients who underwent da Vinci robotic-assisted lobectomy performed by a single board-certified thoracic surgeon at Kaohsiung Chang Gung Memorial Hospital between September 30, 2024, and July 6, 2026. Patients who underwent wedge resection, video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS), segmentectomy, or resection with the da Vinci SP system were excluded. Cases were ordered chronologically, and cumulative sum (CUSUM) of operative time was calculated as the cumulative deviation from the group mean. Because CUSUM based on the mean deviation is a descriptive method without formal decision limits, a 10,000-iteration permutation test was used to construct an empirical 95% decision-limit envelope and to test whether the observed CUSUM path exceeded the range expected under random case ordering; leave-one-out and moving-average sensitivity analyses were also performed. Early and late phases, divided at the CUSUM peak, were compared using the Mann-Whitney test for continuous variables and Fisher's exact test for categorical variables; time to chest tube removal was additionally analyzed with the Kaplan-Meier method and log-rank test. The relationship between case sequence and Charlson Comorbidity Index and surgical-complexity variables (tumor size on pathology, malignant histology, pathologic T category, nodal status, stage, operative lobe, concomitant procedures, lymph node yield, pleural adhesions) was assessed using Spearman's rank correlation and Fisher's exact test; operative time was additionally modeled by linear regression with robust standard errors, adjusted successively for malignancy, tumor size, nodal status, lobe, concomitant procedures, and Charlson index. The CUSUM curve for operative time peaked at case 20 (value 265.0), with a nearly equal local peak at case 10 (260.5); leave-one-out and smoothing analyses showed the identified peak was unstable between cases 10 and 20, and the entire observed CUSUM path remained within the 95% permutation-derived decision-limit envelope (global p = 0.73), indicating that this descriptive breakpoint could not be formally distinguished from random case-to-case variation at this sample size. Operative time did not differ significantly between early (n = 20) and late (n = 27) phases (median 315.0 [IQR 283.8-357.2] vs. 284.0 [268.5-338.0] minutes, p = 0.186) and showed no monotonic trend with case sequence overall (Spearman's ρ = 0.01, p = 0.93). Chest tube duration differed significantly between phases on both Mann-Whitney testing (p = 0.041) and Kaplan-Meier/log-rank analysis (χ²=5.43, p = 0.020), although this and other secondary comparisons were not corrected for multiplicity. Charlson Comorbidity Index increased significantly with case sequence (ρ = 0.34, p = 0.02); the other surgical-complexity variables moved in the same direction without reaching significance (malignant histology 65% vs. 89%, p = 0.07; concomitant procedures 5% vs. 19%, p = 0.22), tumor size did not change (median 2.2 vs. 2.1 cm, p = 0.80), lobe distribution did not differ between phases, and no patient had pleural adhesions. Adjustment for malignancy and these variables did not materially change the association between case sequence and operative time (unadjusted - 0.03 min per case, 95% CI - 1.53 to + 1.46; fully adjusted + 0.12, - 1.48 to + 1.72) or the early-late difference (- 23.1 min unadjusted vs. -16.0 min adjusted; all p ≥ 0.27), although confidence intervals were wide. By the time of the CUSUM-identified breakpoint (lobectomy case 20), the surgeon had already accumulated 39 total robotic console cases when segmentectomy, wedge resection, and da Vinci SP cases are included. In this single-surgeon series, the operative-time CUSUM breakpoint at approximately case 10-20 should be interpreted as an exploratory, descriptive signal rather than a formally validated learning-to-proficiency transition, as it was not statistically distinguishable from random variation and the dichotomized early/late operative-time comparison was not significant. Comorbidity burden increased significantly over the study period and surgical-complexity indicators trended in the same direction, and adjustment for them did not alter the operative-time estimates; there was thus no evidence that the surgeon progressively selected easier cases, but the small sample precludes firm conclusions, and adhesion severity could not be studied because no patient had adhesions, so the findings may not apply to patients with adhesions. The surgeon's cumulative robotic experience at the time of the breakpoint substantially exceeded the lobectomy case count alone once other robotic procedures are considered.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Nocturnal hypoventilation (NH) is an early manifestation of respiratory muscle weakness in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and plays a key role in determining the optimal timing for non-invasive ventilation (NIV). However, several diagnostic definitions of NH have been proposed, and their impact on NH prevalence remains unclear. METHODS: In this cross-sectional study, 56 non-ventilated ALS patients underwent home-based overnight monitoring with transcutaneous carbon dioxide (TcCO2) and pulse oximetry. NH prevalence was assessed using seven definitions derived from daytime arterial blood gases, nocturnal oximetry, and TcCO2 parameters. Agreement between definitions was evaluated using Cohen's and Light's kappa coefficients. RESULTS: NH prevalence varied widely depending on the definition used, ranging from approximately 5% with daytime arterial criteria to 36.7% using peak TcCO2 ≥49 mmHg. Overall concordance among definitions was low (Light's κ = 0.27), indicating that current NH definitions are not interchangeable. CONCLUSIONS: Currently used definitions of NH in ALS show substantial heterogeneity and identify different patient subsets. These findings highlight the need for ALS-specific consensus definitions of NH.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Quantitative fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) biomarkers are associated with prognosis following stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer (ES-NSCLC); however, their relationship with patterns of failure remains poorly defined. We evaluated the prognostic significance of pretreatment metabolic PET parameters following definitive SBRT. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Patients with T1-3N0M0 ES-NSCLC treated with SBRT between January 2010 and December 2024 were identified from a prospectively maintained institutional database. Pretreatment FDG-PET metrics including maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax), mean standardized uptake value (SUVmean), metabolic tumor volume (MTV), and total lesion glycolysis (TLG) were stratified into low-, intermediate-, and high-risk groups. Overall survival (OS); cancer-specific survival; and local, regional, and distant failure were analyzed using competing-risk methods and multivariable Fine-Gray regression. RESULTS: A total of 168 patients were included (median age, 77 years; median follow-up, 34.6 months). Local, regional, and distant failure occurred in 3.6%, 10.1%, and 15.5% of patients, respectively. Increasing TLG, SUVmax, SUVmean, and MTV were associated with inferior OS on univariable analysis, while high-risk TLG (HR, 2.26; P = .014) and SUVmean (HR, 2.72; P = .008) remained independent predictors of worse OS. No PET biomarker predicted local failure. Conversely, high-risk TLG and MTV independently predicted regional recurrence, while high-risk TLG, SUVmax, and SUVmean independently predicted distant metastasis. CONCLUSION: Pretreatment FDG-PET metabolic biomarkers identify patients at increased risk of regional and distant recurrence following SBRT for ES-NSCLC but do not predict local failure after modern ablative radiotherapy. TLG demonstrated the most consistent prognostic performance and may represent a clinically useful biomarker for risk-adapted staging, surveillance, and future treatment intensification strategies.

papers.abstract_en: Central sleep apnea (CSA), commonly seen in patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fractions (HFrEF), is associated with hypoxia, heightened sympathetic activity, and poor clinical outcomes. While several CSA therapies reduce the apnea-hypopnea index, none have been shown to improve long-term important clinical outcomes. Nocturnal oxygen therapy (NOT) represents a physiologically sound approach to the treatment of CSA. Evidence supports the potential benefits of NOT in such patients, but no proof of its effectiveness on hard outcomes exists. Thus, there has been a longstanding need for a randomized controlled trial of NOT for CSA in HFrEF patients. The ideal trial would establish the rationale for NOT by measuring clinically meaningful outcomes, use rigorous methodologies such as double-blinding and a sham control, and optimize safety by delivering oxygen at doses that ameliorate hypoxemia and avoid hyperoxia. Such a trial (LOFT-HF NCT03745898) was indeed eventually sponsored by the National Institute of Heath and was initiated in 2018-2019. However, the trial was halted during the COVID-19 pandemic due to slow enrollment. Findings were recently published and did not provide a firm conclusion but suggested potential harm in the NOT arm based on a very small number of participants. Meanwhile, the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM) published recently new treatment guidelines for CSA, suggesting use NOT in CSA. In this article, we attempt to reconcile the LOFT-HF trial findings with existing literature and the new AASM CSA management guidelines and discuss future research needs.

papers.abstract_en: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. This review evaluated the effects of different mind-body exercises (MBEs) on lung function (LF), exercise capacity (EC), and quality of life (QoL) in adults with stable COPD using Bayesian network meta-analysis (NMA). Eight English and Chinese databases were searched through April 21, 2026. Randomized controlled trials comparing Ba Duan Jin (BDJ), Yi Jin Jing (YJJ), yoga, Liu Zi Jue (LZJ), Tai Chi (TC), and Wu Qin Xi (WQX) with usual care (UC) were included. Outcomes included FEV1, FEV1%pred, FEV1/FVC, FVC, 6-minute walk distance (6MWD), St. George's Respiratory Questionnaire (SGRQ), and COPD Assessment Test (CAT). Bayesian NMA was conducted using R. A total of 111 RCTs involving 9,240 participants were included. Most trials compared individual MBEs with UC, with limited direct head-to-head comparisons among different MBEs. Different MBE modalities showed potential benefits across LF, EC, and QoL outcomes, although effects varied by outcome. According to the surface under the cumulative ranking curve (SUCRA) ranking, Yoga ranked highest for FEV1 (mean difference [MD] = 0.48, 95% credible interval [CrI]: 0.11, 0.85) and FVC (MD = 0.46, 95% CrI: 0.09, 0.83), whereas WQX ranked highest for FEV1/FVC (MD = 8.38, 95% CrI: 4.59, 12.3) and FEV1%pred (MD = 10.2, 95% CrI: 5.25, 15.35). WQX ranked highest for 6MWD, whereas Yoga, TC, and YJJ showed favorable rankings for some QoL-related outcomes. However, these findings should be interpreted cautiously because some interventions were supported by a relatively small number of trials with varying certainty of evidence and potential risk of bias, and the included trials were predominantly conducted in China. MBEs may improve LF, EC, and QoL in adults with stable COPD. Different MBEs showed potential benefits for specific outcomes. However, comparative effects remain uncertain due to limited direct evidence, unequal numbers of available trials, and variability in evidence certainty. Further high-quality head-to-head RCTs are needed to confirm these findings.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The incidence of non-small cell lung cancer among younger patients is increasing. Current literature predominantly reflects patients with advanced-stage disease. The clinicopathologic and somatic genomic features of young patients with early-stage lung adenocarcinoma, including the contribution of smoking-associated and non-EGFR drivers, are less well defined. Herein, we characterize these features in patients aged 50 years or younger with pathologic stage I lung adenocarcinoma. METHODS: We identified patients aged 50 years or younger with pathologic stage I lung adenocarcinoma who underwent surgical resection at our institution from 2000 to 2023. Clinicopathologic and somatic genomic data were obtained from our prospectively maintained Thoracic Surgery Service Lung Cancer Database. RESULTS: Among 193 patients, the median age was 46 years, 79% were female, and 59% were ever-smokers. Somatic genomic testing was performed in 153 patients (79%), of whom 67% harbored an identifiable oncogenic driver. EGFR mutations and KRAS mutations were each present in 30% of patients, and ALK fusions were present in 11%. Among female patients, EGFR mutations were more frequent in never-smokers than smokers (44% vs. 19%; P = .003), while KRAS mutations were more frequent in smokers than never-smokers (54% vs. 7%; P < .001). CONCLUSION: In our study of patients aged 50 years or younger with resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma, most patients were female, but a substantial proportion had a smoking history. KRAS mutations were as common as EGFR mutations in this select population. These data highlight the genomic heterogeneity observed within this selected cohort of younger patients with resected early-stage lung adenocarcinoma.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) to peripheral lung tumors is associated with radiation-induced bone effects that may predispose patients to chest wall pain and radiation-induced rib fractures. These effects may be inhibited by bisphosphonates. We aimed to determine the impact of risedronate on the radiologic biomarker of rib cortical thickness (CTh) in patients with peripheral lung tumors treated with SBRT. METHODS: This randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 clinical trial enrolled patients with tumors within 2 cm of the chest wall, who were randomized 1:1 to receive risedronate 150 mg prior to SBRT or placebo. CTh was evaluated every 3 months for 1 year. The primary endpoint was the percent change in rib CTh from baseline to 3 months within the higher than 30 Gy isodose region. RESULTS: Seventy-three patients (78 tumors) were randomized and eligible for analysis. Baseline CTh was 1.46 (± 0.34) mm and 1.44 (± 0.42) mm in the placebo and risedronate arms, respectively. The mean percent change from baseline to 3 months within the 30 Gy isodose region was 6.4% (± 18.0) for placebo versus 3.1% (± 17.9) for risedronate (absolute difference: -3.3%; p = 0.44). The absolute differences in percent CTh change from baseline to 6, 9, and 12 months in the risedronate (versus placebo) group were -4.7%, -8.3%, and -11.8%, respectively. CONCLUSION: In patients with peripheral lung tumors treated with SBRT, risedronate did not result in statistically significant differences in CTh within the 30 Gy isodose region. This biomarker of bone changes after SBRT demonstrated increases over time within higher dose regions in the placebo group but remained similar to baseline in the risedronate group. Further studies are needed.

papers.abstract_en: Clinical benefit from first-line PD-1 inhibitor plus chemotherapy in advanced ESCC remains heterogeneous, and PD-L1 alone provides limited stratification. We evaluated plasma lncRNA RIME as a potential biomarker for stratifying first-line treatment outcomes in a multicenter cohort of patients with advanced ESCC. In the chemotherapy plus PD-1 inhibitor group, RIME-low was associated with higher ORR and better PFS/OS, whereas RIME-high was associated with poorer outcomes. Nested-model analyses showed that RIME provided non-redundant outcome information beyond PD-L1, and treatment-by-RIME interactions supported an exploratory predictive signal for ORR and PFS. Overall, plasma RIME was associated with outcome stratification and represents a potential predictive biomarker for immunochemotherapy benefit in ESCC.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Alström syndrome (AS) is a rare multisystemic disorder frequently associated with respiratory complications, which are a major cause of premature death. While fibrosis in multiple organs has been historically suggested as a hallmark of AS, including the lungs, definitive evidence in adult patients remains limited. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective study of adult patients diagnosed as AS seen in our National Multidisciplianry AS clinic from 2010 to 2024. Lung function test and high-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) of the thorax was performed in a subset of patients. Postmortem lung tissue analysis was available from four patients. FINDINGS: A total of 25/41 (61%) of the patients were unable to complete full lung function testing. Among those who did, 67% exhibited reduced lung volumes, with 47% showing decreased diffusing capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide but normal or elevated transfer coefficient for carbon monoxide, indicating extrapulmonary restrictive physiology. HRCT scans in 39 patients showed no evidence of diffuse interstitial lung fibrosis; however, breathing artefacts were common. Historical infantile cardiomyopathy was identified as a risk factor for adult pulmonary dysfunction. Post-mortem pathology reports were obtained from four patients and no diffuse fibrosis in the lung tissue was identified in any of the patients. Pulmonary hypertension and Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome were identified as potential causes of respiratory morbidity and mortality, despite the absence of intrinsic interstitial lung disease. INTERPRETATION: This is the first large cohort study to depict the lung in adult patients with AS. This study provides no evidence for diffuse interstitial lung fibrosis in adult patients with AS, challenging prior assumptions. Pulmonary dysfunction appears mainly due to extrapulmonary restrictive physiology, with infantile cardiomyopathy as a possible risk factor. Pulmonary hypertension and acute respiratory distress syndrome, rather than intrinsic lung disease, likely underlie respiratory morbidity and mortality, highlighting the need for focused cardiopulmonary care. Although this study represents one of the largest single-centre cohorts of patients with AS reported to date, the overall sample size remains limited due to the ultra-rare nature of the disease and findings should be interpreted with caution. FUNDING: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: To assess whether airway pressure release ventilation (APRV) reduces mortality compared with conventional invasive ventilation in adults with established acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), acute lung injury, or conditions considered to confer a high risk of ARDS. METHODS: We searched PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library from inception through August 15, 2026. We analyzed parallel-group randomized trials using random-effects models. Mortality at trial-defined follow-up was the primary outcome. We used Cochrane RoB 2 to assess risk of bias and GRADE to assess certainty of evidence. PROSPERO: CRD420251170819. RESULTS: Nine trials involving 585 participants were included. No mortality benefit was demonstrated (risk ratio 0.95, 95% CI 0.72-1.26). Ventilator-free days showed no clear difference (mean difference [MD] 3.83 days, 95% CI - 1.69 to 9.34; I²=83%). APRV was associated with a higher PaO₂/FiO₂ ratio (MD 56.21 mm Hg, 95% CI 24.63-87.79; I²=84%) and shorter ICU stay (MD - 2.53 days, 95% CI - 4.43 to - 0.64; I²=71%). Ventilation duration showed no clear difference (five trials, 413 participants; MD - 2.44 days, 95% CI - 4.96 to 0.09; I²=78%). Peak airway pressure was lower and mean airway pressure was higher with APRV. CONCLUSION: This synthesis does not establish that APRV improves survival, ventilator-free days, or ventilation duration. Oxygenation and ICU-stay findings require caution because populations, protocols, outcome timing, and risk of bias varied. Certainty of evidence was low to very low. These data do not establish mortality equivalence or superiority over contemporary lung-protective ventilation. TRIAL REGISTRATION: CRD420251170819; registered 17 October 2025.

papers.abstract_en: Sepsis is a heterogeneous syndrome, and pulmonary infection is its commonest source. Pulmonary sepsis carries a particularly high mortality, especially in patients who develop refractory septic shock, yet it is still managed as a single disease. Conventional diagnostic criteria, based on organ dysfunction, describe the consequences of the host response rather than its biological diversity, and this mismatch helps to explain why immunomodulatory trials have repeatedly failed in unselected patients. In this review we summarise how pathogen characteristics interact with the alveolar immune microenvironment to produce distinct host-response phenotypes, and how those phenotypes are captured by clinical classifiers, plasma protein biomarkers and blood transcriptomic endotypes - among them SRS1/2, Mars1-4, SENECA and USE-1/2. Three problems currently limit translation. The classification systems overlap only in part, and should not be used interchangeably. Endotypes change over time, so a single measurement at baseline can misclassify a patient. And most of the evidence linking particular pathogens to particular phenotypes is associative, and comes from ARDS, general sepsis, severe pneumonia or COVID-19 cohorts rather than from pulmonary sepsis itself. We then review the phenotype-dependent responses to fluid strategy, corticosteroids, statins, endotoxin removal, cytokine-directed therapy and checkpoint inhibition, and consider why several biomarker-guided trials produced pharmacodynamic signals without clinical benefit. Pathogen-informed, repeatedly measured host-response phenotypes, tested in adaptive trials with enrichment, offer the most realistic route to precision immunotherapy in pulmonary sepsis.

papers.abstract_en: Sigma-1 receptor (S1R) is a ligand-operated chaperone involved in the modulation of ion channel function, including the voltage-gated potassium (KV) channels such as KV1.5. KV1.5 channel dysfunction is a characteristic feature of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), and its pharmacological modulation represents an attractive strategy in this context. Here, we investigated whether pharmacological activation of S1R by clinically approved drugs, such as dimemorfan and fluoxetine, enhances KV1.5 channel activity in pulmonary arterial smooth muscle cells (PASMCs). KV currents were recorded using whole-cell patch-clamp in freshly isolated PASMCs from rats, humans, and rats with experimental PAH induced by SU5416 plus hypoxia (SuHx). Pulmonary vascular reactivity was assessed was assessed in isolated pulmonary arteries using wire myography, and protein expression was analysed by Western blot. Dimemorfan and fluoxetine significantly increased DPO-1-sensitive KV currents, corresponding to the KV1.5 component, without affecting DPO-1-insensitive currents. These effects were abolished by pharmacological blockade of S1R, supporting a S1R-dependent mechanism. Increased KV1.5 activity was associated with reduced pulmonary vasoconstrictor responses. The KV1.5-enhancing effects of both compounds were also observed in PASMCs from PAH rats. The ability of dimemorfan to enhance KV currents was also confirmed in freshly isolated human PASMCs. Overall, these findings support a role of S1R as a pharmacological regulator of KV1.5 channel function and provide evidence that clinically approved S1R-active drugs can enhance KV1.5 activity in pulmonary vascular smooth muscle. This pharmacological approach may provide a basis for further investigation of drug repurposing strategies targeting KV1.5 channel dysfunction in PAH.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Respiratory failure is a common and severe syndrome in critical care, associated with poor prognosis, and its incidence and healthcare burden among critically ill patients are increasing. This study aimed to investigate seasonal patterns of respiratory failure admissions and their associations with meteorological factors and to evaluate the contributions of clinical and meteorological features to model-predicted in-hospital mortality. METHODS: This multicenter retrospective observational study included adults with respiratory failure admitted to emergency intensive care units (EICUs) between 2022 and 2024. Clinical and meteorological datasets were linked based on admission time and regional location. Seasonal trends were analyzed using seasonal-trend decomposition with Loess (STL), while quasi-poisson generalized additive models (QP-GAMs) and distributed lag non-linear models (DLNMs) were used to examine meteorological effects. A random forest model combined with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) was used to quantify global and individual feature contributions to model-predicted in-hospital mortality. RESULTS: Among 1,837 critically ill patients with respiratory failure, 57.8% were male, with a median age of 66 years; 34.2% had hypoxemic type and 64.1% hypercapnic type, with overall in-hospital mortality of 54.3%. STL analysis revealed marked seasonal variation, peaking in winter and reaching a minimum in summer. QP-GAMs and DLNMs suggested nonlinear and lagged associations of temperature and relative humidity with monthly respiratory failure admission counts. In the random forest model, age and mechanical ventilation had the largest mean absolute SHAP values, followed by other clinical features. CONCLUSION: This study revealed nonlinear and lagged associations between meteorological factors and monthly respiratory failure admissions, with the highest admission counts observed in winter, followed by spring. In the fitted random forest model, clinical and physiological features contributed more to mortality predictions than meteorological variables.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Inhaled corticosteroid/long-acting β2-agonist (ICS/LABA) combinations are a cornerstone of moderate asthma management that have been approved to treat asthma on the basis of results from randomized controlled trials (RCTs). However, efficacy observed in RCTs does not necessarily translate directly into effectiveness, partly because of lower adherence or persistence and less intensive follow-up structures in routine clinical practice. This has driven interest in real-world evidence (RWE) studies and pragmatic RCTs as sources of evidence complementary to conventional RCTs. We aimed to assess how considering multiple study types could enhance our understanding of ICS/LABA therapy in asthma management. METHODS: We undertook a targeted literature search of PubMed/MEDLINE of RCTs (conventional and pragmatic) and RWE studies evaluating ICS/LABA therapies in patients with moderate asthma through a structured screening approach. RESULTS: Twenty two publications were selected for descriptive comparison. Similar results for ICS/LABA therapies were reported across studies, supporting the generalizability of conventional RCT findings to routine clinical practice. Reported severe exacerbation rates per patient per year (PPPY) were approximately 0.14-0.31 PPPY in conventional RCTs, 0.12-0.47 PPPY in pragmatic RCTs, and overall exacerbation rates 0.07-0.18 in RWE studies, with lower rates reported for ICS/LABA interventions than comparator. Across studies, approximately half of patients reported improvements in asthma control following ICS/LABA treatment. Conventional RCTs reported high treatment persistence and generally higher treatment adherence than pragmatic RCTs or RWE studies; however, the perceived impacts of adherence on treatment effects were mixed between studies. Where reported, lung function data indicated improvements following ICS/LABA treatment, although RWE data were limited. CONCLUSION: Our findings support the view that conventional RCTs, pragmatic RCTs, and RWE studies represent complementary components of a unified evidence continuum that should be considered together to optimize patient care. Integrating evidence across this continuum provides a more comprehensive understanding of ICS/LABA therapy and may better inform personalized treatment decisions in asthma.

papers.title_zh: 干粉吸入剂声学监测估算累积肺递送剂量的24周前瞻性观察研究：103例哮喘患者中4周ELDD与后续ACT下降的关联未达统计学显著（p=0.055），仅在延长至8周的敏感性分析中方显著（p=0.023）
papers.title_en: Translational feasibility of acoustic monitoring for cumulative lung-delivered dose during routine dry powder inhaler use.
papers.authors: Chang MW, Fan CH, Chiu CW, Hu TY, Liao YT, Ke WR, Wu WJ
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Electronics and Electrical Engineering, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Hsinchu, Taiwan.
papers.results: 共采集17,717条有效吸入图谱；平均肺沉积分数32.8 ± 10.4%；平均4周ELDD为2,382 μg。关联分析（48例参与者，166个暴露-结局区间）中较高ELDD与后续探索性ACT下降方向的更低几率相关，但未达统计学显著（p = 0.055）。将暴露窗延长至8周的敏感性分析中，组间差异达到统计学显著（p = 0.023）。系统在24周内无需改装吸入器或监督测试即可在常规门诊连续监测DPI使用。
papers.authors_conclusion: Routine outpatient continuous acoustic monitoring of DPI use was feasible over 24 weeks without inhaler modification or supervised testing. Preliminary association analyses suggested that estimated cumulative pulmonary exposure may relate to subsequent asthma control outcomes, warranting further investigation in larger confirmatory studies.
papers.ai_note: 选择性强调与终点口径问题：预设4周暴露窗的主要关联分析未达统计学显著（p = 0.055），显著性仅出现在事后延长至8周的敏感性分析（p = 0.023），存在反复调整暴露窗直至显著的多重比较/移门柱风险，摘要未说明8周分析是否为预设。结局为'探索性ACT下降方向'的非标准二分衍生指标，且摘要未给出效应量与95%CI。关联分析仅纳入48/103例（约47%）且仅有166个区间，存在子集选择与效能不足，阴性结果可能源于检验效能而非无关联。ELDD为体外模型推导的替代量，非实测肺沉积，且无临床硬终点或常规依从性监测对照。可行性为主要结论，关联性属探索性，作者表述已标注'preliminary'，但正文仍以显著的敏感性分析作为主要叙事支撑。

papers.reason: 为吸入装置客观暴露/依从性监测技术提供可行性与方法学证据，可用于评估哮喘、COPD或胸部肿瘤患者合并气道疾病时的吸入治疗管理工具；但研究人群为非肿瘤哮喘、结局为探索性ACT衍生指标，对胸外科与胸部肿瘤核心诊疗决策（手术选择、随访、结节风险）无直接影响，主要价值限于技术可行性参考。
papers.abstract_en: Conventional inhaler monitoring based on actuation counts does not capture the inhalation profiles that determine pulmonary drug deposition, and existing in vitro metrics are not directly translatable to real-world pulmonary exposure. We report a prospective real-world evaluation of an acoustic sensing system that estimates cumulative pulmonary exposure during routine dry powder inhaler (DPI) use without modifying the inhaler. The system combines noncontact acoustic sensing, acoustic-to-flow reconstruction, and an in-vitro-derived deposition response surface model to estimate lung deposition fraction, accumulated over predefined time windows as the estimated lung-delivered dose (ELDD), an in vitro-derived surrogate of cumulative pulmonary exposure. We evaluated the system in a 24-week prospective observational study of 103 adults with asthma using Turbuhaler to evaluate system feasibility and examine associations between ELDD and subsequent changes in Asthma Control Test (ACT). The system captured 17,717 valid inhalation profiles from the cohort. The mean lung deposition fraction was 32.8 ± 10.4%, and the mean 4-week ELDD was 2,382 μg. In the association analysis (48 participants, 166 exposure-outcome intervals), higher ELDD was associated with lower odds of subsequent exploratory directional ACT decline, although the association did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.055). In a sensitivity analysis extending the exposure window to 8 weeks, the group difference reached significance (p = 0.023), consistent with the known delayed anti-inflammatory effects of inhaled corticosteroids. Continuous acoustic monitoring of DPI use in routine outpatient care was feasible over a 24-week period without inhaler modification or supervised testing. Preliminary association analyses suggested that estimated cumulative pulmonary exposure may relate to subsequent asthma control outcomes, warranting further investigation in larger confirmatory studies.

papers.abstract_en: Silicosis is a progressive fibrotic lung disease characterized by myofibroblast accumulation and excessive extracellular matrix deposition, for which effective therapeutic interventions remain limited. Macrophage to myofibroblast transition (MMT) has emerged as a critical cellular source of myofibroblasts during silicosis, yet the molecular regulators governing this process are not fully understood. Osteoclast stimulatory transmembrane protein (OC-STAMP) is a multi-transmembrane protein originally identified in osteoclast differentiation, but its role in silicosis remains unexplored. In this study, we investigated the expression and functional involvement of OC-STAMP in silicosis using in vivo and in vitro models. We found that OC-STAMP was significantly upregulated in the lung tissues of silicotic mice and MH-S stimulated by SiO2, and was predominantly localized to macrophages. Macrophage-specific conditional knockout of Ocstamp (Ocstampflox/flox; Lyz2-cre) markedly suppressed M2 macrophage polarization and MMT, and attenuated the progress of silicosis. Mechanistically, Ocstamp knockdown attenuated JAK1/STAT6 signaling, whereas Ocstamp overexpression enhanced it, and pharmacological inhibition of JAK1 with Upadacitinib reversed OC-STAMP-induced MMT and signaling activation. Collectively, these findings identify OC-STAMP as a previously unrecognized regulator of MMT via JAK1/STAT6 signaling, highlighting OC-STAMP as a potential therapeutic target for silicosis and other fibrotic diseases.

papers.abstract_en: Smoke inhalation injury (SII) dramatically elevates burn patient mortality. Although N6-methyladenosine (m6A) methylation is emerging as a central epitranscriptomic regulator of lung inflammation and injury, its specific involvement in SII remains unknown. Using an in vivo mouse SII model and smoke extract-treated MLE-12 cells, we show that smoke exposure downregulates the m6A writer-complex component WTAP and reduces global m6A methylation. WTAP knockdown attenuates epithelial inflammation, apoptosis, and STAT3 activation. Integrating transcriptomics with weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) and MeRIP-qPCR, we identify pIgR as a downstream target: WTAP modifies m6A methylation within the 756/772 region of pIgR mRNA, and its knockdown prolongs pIgR mRNA half-life and elevates pIgR expression. pIgR silencing reverses the protection conferred by WTAP knockdown. These findings define a WTAP/m6A/pIgR axis that shapes the early epithelial response to smoke inhalation and identifies WTAP as a candidate therapeutic target for SII.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Uncontrolled asthma is often associated with recurrent acute exacerbations, progressive and chronic systemic inflammation and decreased lung function, impaired quality of life, and healthcare utilization. A considerable proportion of adult patients with uncontrolled asthma exhibit comorbid elevated symptoms of depression and anxiety. These symptoms are often underrecognized and undertreated in adults with asthma. We examined and synthesized the available literature on the efficacy of pulmonary rehabilitation, cognitive behavioral therapy, and antidepressant drug therapy, and healthcare utilization in adults with uncontrolled asthma with comorbid depression and anxiety. INTERPRETATION AND DISCUSSION: The prevalence of anxiety in adults with uncontrolled asthma ranges from 25 to 54%, and depression ranges from 14 to 50%. To date, the available literature on the efficacy of pulmonary rehabilitation, cognitive behavioral therapy, and antidepressant drug therapy in the treatment of anxiety and depression is limited. Untreated depression and anxiety are associated with recurrent episodes of acute exacerbations, hospitalizations, poorer quality of life, longer hospital stays, and emergency healthcare utilization. Therefore, well-controlled randomized controlled trials are needed to improve the evidence base for optimal care of adults with uncontrolled asthma and ideally to reduce healthcare utilization.
